# Hiyd

> Hiyd is the Jekyll companion app: a fast, private iOS app for iPhone and iPad that lets you
> draft Markdown posts with YAML front matter and publish them straight to a GitHub repository.
> A companion Chrome extension captures link posts from Chromium browsers.

Hiyd is made in the UK by thechels.uk. It is free, with an optional subscription and tips to
support development. Requires iOS / iPadOS 18.6 or later.

Key facts:
- Posts are stored as .md files in the user's own iCloud Drive (Files › iCloud Drive › Hiyd) and
  sync across the user's devices. There is no Hiyd account and no Hiyd server.
- `title` and `date` front matter are always included. Users can add custom default fields as
  Text, List or Boolean values, reorder them, and delete them.
- GitHub publishing: add up to five repositories, each with a fine-grained personal access token
  (Contents: Read and write) stored in the iOS Keychain. Files are committed to a folder
  (default `_posts`) on the repository's default branch via the GitHub Contents API. Commit
  message templates support {filename}, {title}, {datetime}. 5 MB file limit.
- No analytics or tracking in the app. The only outbound network request is to api.github.com,
  and only when the user chooses to publish.
- Face ID / Touch ID / passcode app lock is optional.
- Shortcuts / Siri via App Intents: Create Note, Create File, List Files, Get File,
  Get File Content, Search Notes, Open Page, Open File.
- Deep links: hiyd://create, hiyd://archive, hiyd://settings,
  hiyd://create?title=...&body=..., hiyd://file?filename=example.md&restore=true
- Appearance: light/dark mode, custom tint colour, multiple app icons.
- File formats: reads and writes .md and .txt. Output is standard Jekyll-compatible Markdown.
- Chrome extension (separate tool, Manifest V3): select text on a page, right-click > "Hiyd
  Capture", and save a Markdown quote post. Front matter fields: date, title, cited (page
  author), link (page URL), seo (page description), tags (page keywords), plus up to 5 custom
  key/value pairs set in the extension's settings. Each selected line is prefixed with "> ".
  Designed for Daring Fireball-style linked list / quote posts.

## Apps & Extensions

- [Hiyd on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/hiyd/id6746853559): iOS and iPadOS app.
- [Hiyd on the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hiyd/hkeklhoojnogpfmiikadpcmkmpldhpce): Chromium browser extension for link posts.
